A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Wanderland work and contain complete main text and Appendices A–E. Text extraction and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the figures, tables, equations, and appendix content.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction, novel-view synthesis, and navigation experiments in Section 4, plus geometric-prior comparisons and component ablations in Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 2–5 and appendix Tables II–III.

M1.justification: The multi-sensor reconstruction pipeline, Gaussian initialization, depth regularization, view augmentation, mesh extraction, and simulation integration remain unchanged, including their appendix descriptions.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 530-scene indoor-outdoor dataset and retain the same reconstruction, interpolated/extrapolated view synthesis, and embodied-navigation task coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the reconstruction, rendering, and navigation experiments in Tables 2–5 and the appendix comparisons. No evaluated baseline is added or removed.

E3.justification: Data splits, evaluation metrics, image downsampling, training settings, and navigation procedures are unchanged. Both retain the below-500-image reconstruction setup, 15,000-step Gaussian training, and 1,000-step navigation episode cap.

E4.justification: Appendix Tables II–III retain the same geometric-prior comparison and component ablations. Mesh, semantic-consistency, simulation-environment, and supplementary qualitative analyses also remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 2 retains the same across-scene mean/median reporting. Neither version adds or revises repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Experimental values and findings in Tables 2–5, appendix Tables II–III, and the qualitative comparisons are unchanged. For example, Table 3 retains Wanderland's interpolated/extrapolated PSNR values of 20.37/17.92.

T1.justification: The metric definitions and reward formula in Appendix E, Equations (1)–(12), are mathematically unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about geometrically grounded simulation, limitations of vision-only reconstruction, and Wanderland's benchmarking role.

C2.justification: Interpretations linking geometric accuracy to rendering and navigation reliability remain unchanged. Section 5 retains the same limitations concerning 1 FPS capture and unmodeled environmental dynamics.

D1.justification: Implementation details, Table I hyperparameters, preprocessing, mesh construction, instruction generation, and PPO settings remain unchanged. Project and device access information is also retained; the new funding acknowledgment adds no technical reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Table 1 changes ScanNet's source classification from tripod-based capture to a mobile 3D scanner. Correspondingly, Section 2 replaces 'tripod-based' with 'dedicated' RGB-D capture when describing classic datasets. The cited works and broader research positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 makes the localized Section 2 wording change, adds NVIDIA Academic Grant Program support to the acknowledgment, and updates the version/date stamp. Section organization and the remaining narrative are retained.

P2.justification: Table 1 replaces ScanNet's tripod icon with the mobile-scanner icon. The expanded acknowledgment causes bibliography reflow across pages 9–12. Experimental figures, table structures, and appendix layouts otherwise remain effectively unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 refines the description of ScanNet's capture source and adds funding attribution, but preserves the methods, experimental evidence, analyses, limitations, and reproducibility information. These localized contextual and presentation edits do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
